boundaries.scope: official Binance Spot or USD-M testnet/Demo origin, product and API-key fingerprint
boundaries.logical_queries_without_cache: one exact-client-ID order query, then at most one exact-order-ID trade page; existing bounded GET transport retries still apply
boundaries.zero_fill: requires exact terminal order with zero cumulative base and quote; no fill request
boundaries.completeness: distinct trade IDs, exact base/quote sums and exact price times quantity; no guessed rounding tolerance
boundaries.commissions: signed decimal amounts grouped by native asset; no valuation or base-inventory deduction inferred
boundaries.storage: additive opening_recovery table inside an already scope-bound v2 journal; schema1 is not migrated
boundaries.persisted_fields: validated execution allowlist and exact intent binding, not raw arbitrary API payloads
